title: ​Mattel Disney and Pixar Toy Story 5 Jessie Action Figure | 7-inch Playscale, 1 Key Character, 8+ Posable Joints, Movie-Accurate Design
features: ​The magic of Disney and Pixar's Toy Story! Bring the friendship and adventure of the movies home with these action figures of favorite characters. Each sold separately, subject to availability.
​Ready for fun! With true-to-film design and posable joints, these figures are ready to round up some fun.
​Pose-perfect! With 8 to 14 points of articulation, these figures are ready for dynamic poses. Re-enact scenes from the movies or imagine your own storylines.
​Play scale! These figures are designed at 7-inch scale, the perfect size for play. At scale means they're accurate in size to each other as they appear on screen, for realistic play or display.
3 years and up! This Jessie figure is suitable for Toy Story fans ages 3 years and older and comes in different packaging styles.​
